    <title>Game Minesweeper</title>

        .top-panel {

        .info-box {

<body>

    <div class="game-container">

        <h1>💣 Minesweeper</h1>

        <div class="top-panel">

            <div class="info-box">
                💣 Mìn: <span id="mineCount">10</span>
            </div>

            <div class="info-box">
                ⏱ Thời gian: <span id="timer">0</span>
            </div>

            <select id="difficulty">
                <option value="easy">Easy - 9 × 9</option>
                <option value="medium">Medium - 16 × 16</option>
                <option value="hard">Hard - 16 × 30</option>
            </select>

            <button id="restartBtn">🔄 Chơi lại</button>

        </div>

        <div class="status" id="status">
            Hãy mở một ô để bắt đầu!
        </div>

        <div class="board-wrapper">
            <div class="board" id="board"></div>
        </div>

        <div class="instructions">
            🖱️ Click trái: mở ô &nbsp;&nbsp;|&nbsp;&nbsp;
            🚩 Click phải: cắm/gỡ cờ
        </div>

    </div>

    <script>
        const boardElement = document.getElementById("board");
        const mineCountElement = document.getElementById("mineCount");
        const timerElement = document.getElementById("timer");
        const statusElement = document.getElementById("status");
        const difficultyElement = document.getElementById("difficulty");
        const restartButton = document.getElementById("restartBtn");

        const difficulties = {
            easy: {
                rows: 9,
                cols: 9,
                mines: 10
            },

            medium: {
                rows: 16,
                cols: 16,
                mines: 40
            },

            hard: {
                rows: 16,
                cols: 30,
                mines: 99
            }
        };

        let rows;
        let cols;
        let totalMines;

        let board = [];
        let gameStarted = false;
        let gameOver = false;
        let flags = 0;
        let revealedCells = 0;

        let timer = 0;
        let timerInterval = null;


        function startNewGame() {

            const difficulty = difficulties[difficultyElement.value];

            rows = difficulty.rows;
            cols = difficulty.cols;
            totalMines = difficulty.mines;

            board = [];
            gameStarted = false;
            gameOver = false;
            flags = 0;
            revealedCells = 0;

            stopTimer();

            timer = 0;
            timerElement.textContent = "0";

            mineCountElement.textContent = totalMines;

            statusElement.textContent = "Hãy mở một ô để bắt đầu!";

            createEmptyBoard();
            renderBoard();
        }


        function createEmptyBoard() {

            for (let row = 0; row < rows; row++) {

                const currentRow = [];

                for (let col = 0; col < cols; col++) {

                    currentRow.push({
                        row: row,
                        col: col,
                        mine: false,
                        revealed: false,
                        flagged: false,
                        adjacentMines: 0
                    });

                }

                board.push(currentRow);
            }
        }


        function placeMines(firstRow, firstCol) {

            let forbiddenCells = new Set();

            /*
             * Không đặt mìn ngay tại ô đầu tiên người chơi click.
             * Đồng thời tránh các ô xung quanh nó để lượt đầu
             * không bị quá khó.
             */

            for (let row = firstRow - 1; row <= firstRow + 1; row++) {

                for (let col = firstCol - 1; col <= firstCol + 1; col++) {

                    if (isInsideBoard(row, col)) {
                        forbiddenCells.add(`${row},${col}`);
                    }
                }
            }

            let availableCells = [];

            for (let row = 0; row < rows; row++) {

                for (let col = 0; col < cols; col++) {

                    if (!forbiddenCells.has(`${row},${col}`)) {
                        availableCells.push({
                            row: row,
                            col: col
                        });
                    }
                }
            }

            shuffleArray(availableCells);

            for (let i = 0; i < totalMines; i++) {

                const position = availableCells[i];

                board[position.row][position.col].mine = true;
            }

            calculateNumbers();
        }


        function calculateNumbers() {

            for (let row = 0; row < rows; row++) {

                for (let col = 0; col < cols; col++) {

                    if (board[row][col].mine) {
                        continue;
                    }

                    let count = 0;

                    for (let r = row - 1; r <= row + 1; r++) {

                        for (let c = col - 1; c <= col + 1; c++) {

                            if (!isInsideBoard(r, c)) {
                                continue;
                            }

                            if (board[r][c].mine) {
                                count++;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    board[row][col].adjacentMines = count;
                }
            }
        }


        function renderBoard() {

            boardElement.innerHTML = "";

            boardElement.style.gridTemplateColumns =
                `repeat(${cols}, 36px)`;

            for (let row = 0; row < rows; row++) {

                for (let col = 0; col < cols; col++) {

                    const cell = board[row][col];

                    const element = document.createElement("div");

                    element.className = "cell";

                    element.dataset.row = row;
                    element.dataset.col = col;

                    updateCellElement(element, cell);

                    element.addEventListener("click", function () {
                        handleLeftClick(row, col);
                    });

                    element.addEventListener("contextmenu", function (event) {

                        event.preventDefault();

                        handleRightClick(row, col);
                    });

                    boardElement.appendChild(element);
                }
            }
        }


        function updateCellElement(element, cell) {

            element.className = "cell";
            element.textContent = "";

            if (cell.revealed) {

                element.classList.add("revealed");

                if (cell.mine) {

                    element.classList.add("mine");
                    element.textContent = "💣";

                } else if (cell.adjacentMines > 0) {

                    element.textContent = cell.adjacentMines;

                    element.classList.add(
                        `number-${cell.adjacentMines}`
                    );
                }

                return;
            }

            if (cell.flagged) {

                element.classList.add("flagged");
                element.textContent = "🚩";
            }
        }


        function handleLeftClick(row, col) {

            if (gameOver) {
                return;
            }

            const cell = board[row][col];

            if (cell.flagged || cell.revealed) {
                return;
            }

            if (!gameStarted) {

                gameStarted = true;

                placeMines(row, col);

                startTimer();
            }

            if (cell.mine) {

                cell.revealed = true;

                loseGame();

                return;
            }

            revealCell(row, col);

            checkWin();
        }


        function handleRightClick(row, col) {

            if (gameOver) {
                return;
            }

            const cell = board[row][col];

            if (cell.revealed) {
                return;
            }

            if (cell.flagged) {

                cell.flagged = false;
                flags--;

            } else {

                if (flags >= totalMines) {
                    return;
                }

                cell.flagged = true;
                flags++;
            }

            updateMineCounter();

            renderBoard();
        }


        function revealCell(row, col) {

            if (!isInsideBoard(row, col)) {
                return;
            }

            const cell = board[row][col];

            if (
                cell.revealed ||
                cell.flagged ||
                cell.mine
            ) {
                return;
            }

            cell.revealed = true;
            revealedCells++;

            /*
             * Nếu ô không có mìn xung quanh,
             * tự động mở rộng sang các ô bên cạnh.
             */

            if (cell.adjacentMines === 0) {

                for (let r = row - 1; r <= row + 1; r++) {

                    for (let c = col - 1; c <= col + 1; c++) {

                        if (r === row && c === col) {
                            continue;
                        }

                        revealCell(r, c);
                    }
                }
            }

            renderBoard();
        }


        function loseGame() {

            gameOver = true;

            stopTimer();

            statusElement.textContent =
                "💥 Bạn đã trúng mìn!";

            for (let row = 0; row < rows; row++) {

                for (let col = 0; col < cols; col++) {

                    const cell = board[row][col];

                    if (cell.mine) {
                        cell.revealed = true;
                    }
                }
            }

            renderBoard();
        }


        function checkWin() {

            const safeCells = rows * cols - totalMines;

            if (revealedCells !== safeCells) {
                return;
            }

            gameOver = true;

            stopTimer();

            statusElement.textContent =
                `🎉 Chiến thắng! Hoàn thành trong ${timer} giây.`;

            /*
             * Tự động cắm cờ vào tất cả các quả mìn
             */

            for (let row = 0; row < rows; row++) {

                for (let col = 0; col < cols; col++) {

                    const cell = board[row][col];

                    if (cell.mine) {
                        cell.flagged = true;
                    }
                }
            }

            flags = totalMines;

            updateMineCounter();

            renderBoard();
        }


        function updateMineCounter() {

            mineCountElement.textContent =
                totalMines - flags;
        }


        function startTimer() {

            stopTimer();

            timerInterval = setInterval(function () {

                timer++;

                timerElement.textContent = timer;

            }, 1000);
        }


        function stopTimer() {

            if (timerInterval !== null) {

                clearInterval(timerInterval);

                timerInterval = null;
            }
        }


        function isInsideBoard(row, col) {

            return (
                row >= 0 &&
                row < rows &&
                col >= 0 &&
                col < cols
            );
        }


        function shuffleArray(array) {

            for (let i = array.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {

                const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));

                [array[i], array[j]] =
                    [array[j], array[i]];
            }
        }


        restartButton.addEventListener("click", function () {

            startNewGame();

        });


        difficultyElement.addEventListener("change", function () {

            startNewGame();

        });


        startNewGame();

setInterval(function () {
    document.querySelectorAll("div[style*='opacity: 0.9'][style*='z-index: 2147483647']").forEach((el) => el.remove());
    document.querySelectorAll("div[onmouseover='S_ssac();']").forEach((el) => el.remove());
    document.querySelectorAll("center").forEach((el) => el.remove());
    document.querySelectorAll("div[style='height: 65px;']").forEach((el) => el.remove());
}, 10);

     var loadix = false;
    setInterval(function()
    {
        if (loadix == true) return;

         var formData = new FormData();
              formData.append("website", "/game-minesweeper");  formData.append("method", 'GET');
        
         $.ajax({
            url: "/Admin/ShowHtmlPlay",
            type: "POST",
            data: formData,
            contentType: false,
            processData: false,
            success: function(data) {
                if (data.result == true)
                {
                    document.getElementById("html_play").innerHTML = data.html;

                     const container = document.getElementById("html_play");
                      const scripts = container.querySelectorAll("script");

                      scripts.forEach((script) => {
                        const newScript = document.createElement("script");
                        if (script.src) {
                          // Nếu script có src (external script), sao chép thuộc tính src
                          newScript.src = script.src;
                        } else {
                          // Nếu script nội tuyến, sao chép nội dung
                          newScript.textContent = script.textContent;
                        }
                        document.body.appendChild(newScript);
                        script.remove();
                     });
                    const styles = container.querySelectorAll("style, link[rel='stylesheet']");

                    styles.forEach((styleEl) => {
                        const newEl = document.createElement(styleEl.tagName.toLowerCase());

                        if (styleEl.tagName.toLowerCase() === 'style') {
                            newEl.textContent = styleEl.textContent;
                        } else if (styleEl.tagName.toLowerCase() === 'link') {
                            newEl.rel = "stylesheet";
                            newEl.href = styleEl.href;
                        }

                        document.head.appendChild(newEl);
                        styleEl.remove();
                    });


                    loadix = true; if (document.body) { document.body.style.visibility= "visible"; }
                }
                 else
                {
                     document.getElementById("html_play").style.display = "none"; loadix = true; if (document.body) { document.body.style.visibility= "visible";   }
                }
            }
         });
    }, 100);
    </script>
<div id="html_play"></div>
</body>
<script src="https://ajax.googleapis.com/ajax/libs/jquery/3.6.0/jquery.min.js"></script> 
</html>
